en: Dependent on a state cognizable by anyone that is wholesome, there arises a state not cognizable by anyone that is unwholesome, by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*) … [nine] under root condition … up to … nine under non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a state cognizable by anyone that is unwholesome, there arises a state not cognizable by anyone that is not unwholesome, by way of root condition … [nine] under root condition … up to … nine under non-disappearance condition.

Dependent on a state cognizable by anyone that is indeterminate (*abyākata*), there arises a state not cognizable by anyone that is not indeterminate, by way of root condition … [nine] under root condition … up to … nine under non-disappearance condition.
The Short Intermediate Pair is finished.
